title.value: M ASAKHA NEWS: N EWS T OPIC C LASSIFICATION FOR A FRICAN LANGUAGES
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: M ASAKHA NEWS: N EWS T OPIC C LASSIFICATION FOR A FRICAN LANGUAGES

extractions.description: The paper introduces MasakhaNEWS, a new benchmark dataset for news topic classification covering 16 languages widely spoken in Africa. It evaluates baseline models and explores alternatives to full fine-tuning of language models for zero-shot and few-shot learning.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on NLP techniques and dataset creation for African languages, not directly on sustainable development, even though the news topics could potentially relate to it.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: African languages are severely under-represented in NLP research due to lack of datasets covering several NLP tasks.

primary_category.justification: The paper's primary focus is on NLP and dataset creation for news classification, not directly related to any specific climate or ecological sustainable development category.
